title: Implement Phase 1: Print Mastery (Lessons 1-8) - Beginner Friendly
body:
# 🔧 Implement Phase 1: Print Mastery (Lessons 1-8)

**Parent Issue**: #2767 Section 1 Redesign

## Goal
Redesign lessons 1-8 to follow proper beginner progression with cumulative learning.

## Current Status
- [x] **Lesson 1**: Fixed (Hello World + simple emoticon)
- [ ] **Lesson 2**: Needs redesign 
- [ ] **Lesson 3**: Needs redesign
- [ ] **Lesson 4**: Needs redesign
- [ ] **Lesson 5**: Needs redesign
- [ ] **Lesson 6**: Needs redesign
- [ ] **Lesson 7**: Needs redesign
- [ ] **Lesson 8**: Needs redesign

## New Lesson Design

### Lesson 1: ✅ Hello World + Simple Emoticon
- **Concepts**: `print()`, strings in quotes
- **Exercise**: Hello World + `:)` emoticon
- **Code lines**: 3-4 lines
- **Status**: COMPLETED

### Lesson 2: Multiple Print Statements
- **New concept**: Multiple print() statements
- **Uses from L1**: print(), strings
- **Exercise**: Print name, age, favorite color (3 simple prints)
- **Code lines**: 3-4 lines

### Lesson 3: Comments
- **New concept**: `#` comments
- **Uses from L1-2**: print(), multiple prints
- **Exercise**: Add comments to L2 exercise + print a joke with comments
- **Code lines**: 4-5 lines

### Lesson 4: Print with Spacing  
- **New concept**: `print()` with no text for blank lines
- **Uses from L1-3**: all previous concepts
- **Exercise**: Personal intro with spacing between sections
- **Code lines**: 5-6 lines

### Lesson 5: Simple Patterns
- **New concept**: Repeated characters `*`, `-`, `=`
- **Uses from L1-4**: all previous concepts  
- **Exercise**: Create simple border around text
- **Code lines**: 5-6 lines

### Lesson 6: Basic Text Formatting
- **New concept**: Text alignment with spaces
- **Uses from L1-5**: all previous concepts
- **Exercise**: Centered text with border
- **Code lines**: 5-7 lines

### Lesson 7: Print Practice Review
- **New concept**: None (review lesson)
- **Uses from L1-6**: ALL previous concepts combined
- **Exercise**: Personal business card using all learned concepts
- **Code lines**: 8-10 lines

### Lesson 8: Print Mastery Project
- **New concept**: None (mastery project)
- **Uses from L1-7**: ALL concepts from Phase 1
- **Exercise**: Create a simple poster/flyer design
- **Code lines**: 10-12 lines

## 📝 Exercise Complexity Rules
- **Max 3-7 lines of code** for lessons 1-6
- **Max 8-12 lines** for review/mastery lessons 7-8
- **Each exercise uses ALL previous concepts**
- **Only 1 new concept per lesson**
- **Simple, relatable scenarios** (no business/professional themes)

## ✅ Success Criteria
- [ ] Each lesson builds on ALL previous lessons
- [ ] Exercises are achievable by true beginners
- [ ] No cognitive overload (1 concept max per lesson)
- [ ] Extensive repetition of core concepts
- [ ] Students feel confident and successful

## 🎯 Next Steps
1. Implement lessons 2-8 following the design above
2. Test exercises with beginner-level difficulty
3. Ensure all exercises work with the validation system
4. Move to Phase 2 (Variables) after Phase 1 completion

**Estimated effort**: 2-3 hours
